meta.name: roadmap
meta.description: Plan and execute entire application builds. Generates phased delivery roadmaps, then executes them autonomously — phase by phase, committing at milestones, deploying, testing, and continuing until done or stuck. Modes: plan (generate roadmap), start (begin executing), resume (continue from where you left off), status (show progress). Triggers: 'roadmap', 'start building', 'resume the build', 'keep going', 'build the whole thing', 'execute the roadmap', 'what phase are we on'.

copy.tagline: 自动规划并分阶段构建完整应用，每阶段提交、部署、测试。
